h: The Colors of Wine and the Light Beyond Them

p: At the third meal of Shabbos
it is brought in the holy Zohar
and corresponding to the two colors of wine
and the seventy words of the Kiddush of Vayechulu,
That is, "yayin" equals seventy in gematria,
that is, the wine of the Oral Torah
(as it says in the Ra'aya Mehemna, Eikev):
שֶׁבַּתּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה יֵשׁ ע׳ פָּנִים
for in the Oral Torah there are seventy facets,
corresponding to which there are seventy of the Sanhedrin,
so that there can be seventy opinions
And the two colors, white and red,
are the holiness of Avraham and Yitzchak,
And it says that corresponding to the two colors
וְשָׁמוֹר כְּלָל שס״ה מִצְוֹת לֹא תַעֲשֶׂה
as it says in the holy Zohar
And it is brought in the Yerushalmi (chapter HaRo'eh, Berachos 9:5):
for if you come to hate,
and one who loves does not hate;
for if you come to rebel,
the white color, the aspect of Chesed;
and through this he was zealous
(בְּפֵירוּשׁ רַשִׁ״י לְרִי״ף עֲבוֹדָה זָרָה פֶּרֶק א)
(in Rashi's commentary on the Rif, Avodah Zarah chapter 1):
"Carefulness — one who guards himself from sins, etc.;
And in the holy Zohar (this parashah, 181b):
הוּא כְּמוֹ יַעֲקֹב אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
is like Yaakov Avinu, alav hashalom,
who is the aspect of Tiferes
as it says in the pasuk (Bereishis 37:9–10),
"and behold, the sun and the moon, etc.";
"Shall I and your mother indeed come";
and in the Midrash (Bereishis Rabbah, beginning of Vayeitzei):
who revealed to him that My name is 'sun'?"
the aspects of Chesed and Gevurah.
who was also the aspect of the sun,
as it says in the holy Zohar
and that one from the soul"
הָיָה גַּם כֵּן צָרִיךְ תְּרֵין דְּרוֹעִין
and Aharon was on the right,
that is, the aspect of the Oral Torah,
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ב קסו, ב)
as it says in the holy Zohar (Zohar II 166b),
And therefore, when they made the calf,
is included in the Written Torah,
that Nachshon was the left arm;
and it is from him that Mashiach will come,
and the main revelation of the Oral Torah
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּמִּדְרָשׁ (קֹהֶלֶת רַבָּה ב, א)
as it says in the Midrash (Koheles Rabbah 2:1):
כָּל הַתּוֹרָה שֶׁאַתְּ לָמֵד בָּעוֹלָם הַזֶּה
"All the Torah that you learn in this world
compared with the Torah of the World to Come"
that is, the days of Mashiach,
for he will repair all the first blemish,
because he died only through the counsel of the serpent
because he will repair the entire blemish,
And Nachshon is also called Nachshon
and the letters vav-nun are a diminutive,
And according to this one understands
מַה שֶּׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ג קנו, א)
what is written in the holy Zohar (Zohar III 156a)
and Nachshon ben Aminadav is blemished."
Nachshon ben Aminadav have with the mann?
But the intent of the holy Zohar
is according to those who say here
was the left arm of Moshe,
and since the holy Zohar says there
to the level of the feminine,
And similar to what the holy Zohar says (184a):
he is the right of the moon,
that the Clouds of Glory departed
and not in the merit of Elazar
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ שָׁם קפג, א)
(as it says in the holy Zohar there, 183a);
that Nachshon ben Aminadav is blemished,
the left arm of the sun.
at the first two meals of Shabbos,
which correspond to Avraham and Yitzchak,
for they correspond to the two colors of wine,
and as it says in the holy Zohar (183b):
through an act or through a word, etc."
the light of the Oral Torah,
This is not so at the third meal,
שֶׁהוּא כְּנֶגֶד יַעֲקֹב אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
which corresponds to Yaakov Avinu, alav hashalom,
that is, the root light of the Written Torah,
who was also the aspect of the sun;
for this there is no place for arousal
וְלָכֵן לֹא נִתְקַן קִידּוּשׁ עַל הַיַּיִן
and therefore Kiddush over wine was not instituted.
